title: additionalProperties variants
description: A fixture, not a production schema. Six ways an object can declare additionalProperties, so the generator's handling of each is a test result rather than a claim. See PSD-0001 §6.

propsTrue.description: Known fields plus arbitrary extras — the combination people usually reach for. Generates an unusable field; see the test.

propsFalse.description: Closed object. What every schema under docs/jsonschema/character/v1alpha uses.

propsTyped.description: Known fields plus extras constrained to one type.

bareTrue.description: Free-form object. The case the generator handles correctly.

bareTyped.description: Free-form object with a typed value. Also handled correctly.

propsOmitted.description: The control: additionalProperties absent, which JSON Schema treats as true.
